naruto.book.page1:
So you want to be a shinobi.

Open the jutsu menu with J. Every technique is cast by pressing a short string of hand seals - the keys for chakra, shape and nature.
naruto.book.page2:
Chakra is your fuel.

C C charges it. It trickles back on its own, faster at night if you have an affinity, and a full night's sleep refills it completely.
naruto.book.page3:
Techniques are bought, not given.

J, then Skill Tree. Experience buys skill points (10 XP each); points buy nodes. Most techniques - and even the double jump - start locked.
naruto.book.page4:
Start with the basics.

C B B V calls a shadow clone. Hold the last key to sit down and meditate with it instead: clones feed you chakra and speed up every cooldown.
naruto.book.page5:
Scrolls are found, not crafted.

Strongholds, bastions and the ends of the world hide scrolls. Read one and its technique can be learned; a duplicate sharpens the technique you already know.
naruto.book.page6:
Titles follow deeds.

Genin, Chunin, Jonin, S-rank - the village promotes on learned skills and on the great monsters you bring down. Keep the handbook; the rest you learn on the road.
